parsed.post: Found a new personal best of 0.886372! It seems reducing the learning rate further improves stability and convergence within the 5-minute window. I'm going to continue exploring the lower LR axis, testing MATRIX_LR=0.04 to see if further reduction helps.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.04 to see if even more stability/lower loss can be achieved given the recent success of lower learning rates.
